description: Policy for data-dependent jobs: which asset source classes, staging adapters and caches a worker may use. Asset payloads never live in Git or in the generic verification core; descriptors name them by namespaced id, version and digest only.

adapters.note: An adapter is a project-owned implementation behind a staging method. Only allowlisted methods are ever invoked; credentials are resolved after authorization, never before.

cache.note: Cache hit preference is soft. Source class, authorization scope and adapter allowlist are hard constraints.

costModel.note: Staging cost is the number of MiB that must be fetched; the scheduler may weigh it, never override authorization.

evidence.forbid: payload bytes, file contents, licensed filenames and absolute worker paths
